scope: First saved S07/U1 compiler attempt in the incomplete Adapter-v2 B prefix

front_contract.scientific_role: retain at least one mechanism-owned unedited boundary witness per directed interface

retained_front_floor_result.terminal_observation: all three retained works returned zero additional progress for the final 51-pixel requests

mechanistic_interpretation: The saved planner did not execute all eight nuclei-preflight-feasible interfaces before reporting underfill.
Five single-anchor interfaces were excluded deterministically because floor(1 * 0.75) is zero and retaining one unselected anchor also leaves a selection limit of zero.
The three retained multi-anchor interfaces then saturated 51 pixels below the frozen floor.

This identifies the directional front admission rule as a concrete reachable-area bottleneck, but does not prove that any excluded interface contains 51 legal pixels or that admitting it would produce a topology-valid result.

candidate_research_direction.proposal: Evaluate a deterministic contiguous subdivision of a long single anchor into at least two subanchors, recompute nuclei feasibility for the resulting subanchors, and retain the existing 0.75 fraction and minimum-one-unselected-witness constraints.
must_not_do: do not disable the unedited-boundary witness requirement
do not lower the 14/27 percent tissue floors
do not treat subdivision as a qualification update
do not run S07 or reserved evaluation patients without a new SHA-bound authorization

limits: The B business process is incomplete and has no receipt or completion marker.
Interface indices are the ordered interfaces in the saved first-attempt observation, not cross-case biological identifiers.
The trace does not save a complete counterfactual execution for the five excluded interfaces.
The result is from one development case and does not establish cross-patient generality.
